svg.title: In the anchor copy choose a maximum-cardinality subset containing the distinguished anchor with pairwise lattice separation at least B2. Each omitted position is at separation < B2 from a selected one, or it could be adjoined. Assign each point to such a representative and each representative to itself. This is a surjection with an anchor-fixing section. When separation failed the subset is proper, so its size decreases. Repeat the relative selection in every copy; reflection and translation preserve separation and the previously proved cross-copy estimate makes the whole selected configuration separated. If two finer points have parents at separation < B2 m, the half-block deviations from embedded parents give sep(x, y) ≤Lm(Bm + Bm+1 + 1)2 =: cm.
